verses.text: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.

segments.text: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.

verses.text: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

segments.text: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

verses.text: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.

segments.text: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.

verses.text: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright—for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.

segments.text: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright—for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.

verses.text: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.

segments.text: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.

verses.text: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.

segments.text: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.

verses.text: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

segments.text: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

verses.text: His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.

segments.text: His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.

verses.text: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.

segments.text: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.

verses.text: The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.
